title: How to count
key_idea: The central method: to show $|A| = |B|$, find an explicit bijection $\varphi: A \to B$. To find $|A|$, express $A$ as a disjoint union or a Cartesian product. Generating functions package infinitely many counts into one algebraic object $f(x) = \sum_n a_n x^n$.
summary: **To be filled in when you reach this section.** Topics: bijective proof, product rule, sum rule, two-line notation for permutations, basic generating function setup, the transfer matrix method at its simplest. This section sets the vocabulary for the entire book.
